# Figures for MAS Fiscal 2017

## Key Figures

- **MASCO (2015):** $200.79 (from the 10-K report)
- **S&P 500 Index (2015):** $151.94 (from the 10-K report)
- **MASCO (2016):** $227.08 (from the 10-K report)
